target_customer: Korean households booking cleaning, moving and other home services, plus independent service partners
problem: Booking trustworthy home cleaning in Korea was offline and uneven in quality; Miso offers online booking with vetted providers.
business_model: Marketplace take rate on home services bookings

founders.name: Victor Ching
prior_employers: Delivery Hero Korea (ran product and engineering)
previous_startups: Yogiyo (co-founder, per Korea Times 2017 via search summary)
Spoqa / Dodo Point (sold to Yanolja, per search summary)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as sole founder. Miso website names him as CEO.

competitors.name: WaHome
competitors.what: On-demand home cleaning startup in Seoul
competitors.funding_then: 1 million dollar seed round in 2015, per TechCrunch

competitors.name: Daeri Jubu
competitors.what: Seoul startup offering an alternative to traditional cleaning agencies

technical_complexity.rationale: A booking app with scheduling and payments for a marketplace is standard engineering; the hard work is supply quality and operations.

defensibility.rationale: Repeat bookings and two sided supply built scale in Korea (10 million cumulative orders claimed on site), but competitors in Seoul were many at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or bought it in sources opened; it expanded to over 1,000 services by its site claim.

market_need_then: YC's 2016 profile described home cleaning as a 5 billion dollar industry in South Korea, still growing, and Miso offered high quality on demand cleaning against traditional agencies.

branding.name_origin: Miso means smile in Korean; sources state the meaning but no source states the founders' naming reason.
branding.domain_note: Company uses miso.kr, a Korean country domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly consumer service voice; site claims Korea's number one home service

branding.brand_signature: The word for smile in Korean, matching a service positioned around happy households
branding.community_and_virality: Company site says over 10 million cumulative orders and about 9 in 10 customers satisfied (company claim). A Forbes 30 under 30 blog post is on the company blog.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong local recognition claim by the company (10 million orders) and a warm Korean word as name, but name collides with other Miso companies abroad and independent brand press was not found.

pivots.to: Broad home services platform with moving, repair, internet and appliance rental
pivots.why: Site and later press show expansion to over 1,000 services; dates and reasons not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Miso started with home cleaning in Seoul, joined YC in Summer 2016 and raised an 8 million dollar Series A in September 2018. It is active with about 300 people and claims over 10 million orders and expansion across home services. A 2022 report cited gross booking income near 128 million dollars. Later funding and profitability remain unverified.
notes: A seed of 2.62 million dollars (Dec 2016) appears only on thecompanycheck aggregator, and Series B dated 2022-08 appears only on Caplight with no investor info; both unverified and not recorded as rounds. Series A is 8 million per TechCrunch and about 7.79 million per Wellfound; aggregator lists FundersClub, Social Capital and AddVenture as investors, unverified. thevc.kr shows latest stage Series A with 3 rounds. Totals conflict: 10.6, 10.7 and 7.8 million. Competitor dates rely on the TechCrunch 2016 article summary.
